artboards.title: Request rules — 4th tab: Response deadlines and tolling
The hub lane after — no row changes, just the door

annotations.text: Kevin's call 2026-08-29: deadlines and tolling migrates next, as a 4TH TAB on /setup/request-rules. Drawn appended (rightmost); say the word if it should lead the tab order instead (it is item 2 in the lane). The hub row STAYS — only its door changes (like the other three tabs); lane still 10 rows. The A1 attestation fold extends to it: Attest on this tab signs the deadlines section — a LEGAL section, so the strip's Attest demands Senior Legal or the Director (the hub gate already enforces this on the deadlines row).

Left column = the R1 law-panel pattern: the doc's 4 rules (TX-0008/0009/0010/TX-S04) with statute popups, plus the clock-presence list (5 statutory; the other 5 named concepts are city-target-only — the tab renders 2 target rows) so the law's full set is visible. The catastrophe suspension renders as an honest no-config line — it lands on no clock; the engine pauses everything while one is declared.

Editing model (the fee-law rule, applied here): STATUTORY clock figures render as law, never editable in place — a change goes through the section's proposal composer with a citation (the BW9b path, which keeps working behind this tab). The two SERVICE TARGETS (acknowledge / complete) are the city's own numbers, editable directly on the tab; blank = no target. Toll reasons are engine-defined and display-only.

REAL FINDING pulled from live: the holiday calendar is EMPTY (0 days) while every statutory clock counts business days — deadlines currently land EARLIER than the law requires (safe direction, but wrong). The tab surfaces it as the one needs-attention item with a one-click 'Load the US federal set'. OPEN QUESTION for the build: is the federal-set seed enough, or does the city need its own holiday upload (the fixture ships a US-federal 2026-27 list that never reached live)?

Build implications: TAB_CONCEPTS gains the deadlines concept domain (rules from the template, same collectRules walk) · timer table reuses ruleEditors.timerTable (deadline + clock_matrix domains) · deadlines hub row door → /setup/request-rules?tab=deadlines + foldSections:['deadlines'] · service-target writes are plain deadline-domain edits (non-legal fields), statutory ones stay proposal-gated · RequestRulesPage laneIndex map gains deadlines (item 2 of 10) · verify_request_rules grows a D-tab section; verify_deadline_rules/clock_matrix untouched.
